jutsu.canon_description: A basic Fire Release technique, where the user exhales a flame breath from their mouth. As shown by Hiruzen, this technique can be used in conjunction with Earth Release: Earth Dragon Bullet to ignite the projectiles fired by the latter technique, making it more devastating.

jutsu.name: Genjutsu Shibari (Genjutsu Bağı)
jutsu.canon_description: As the name suggests, the user binds the opponent in a genjutsu, rendering them incapable of movement. jutsu.name: Genjutsu: Suzune Bunshin (Zil Sesi Klonu)
jutsu.canon_description: The user utilises the ringing of bells to produce a sound wave that travels through the eardrum directly into the target's brain. This paralyses the victim while also causing them to hallucinate, seeing multiple images of the user, which makes it difficult for them to tell the real one from the illu

jutsu.name: Shimogakure no Jutsu (Kırağıya Saklanma)
jutsu.canon_description: The Hiding in Frost Technique produces visually clouding frost by causing the temperature of air to fall below the freezing point, effectively freezing any ambient water vapour in the vicinity. The frost allows the user to become transparent within it. Upon being struck with an attack, the user beco

jutsu.name: Hyōton: Suishōheki (Buz Kristal Duvarı)
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates walls out of ice crystals to detain their opponents. The reflective surfaces of ice can serve as mirrors for certain genjutsu that requires mirrors to work.

jutsu.name: Hyōton: Mangehyō (On Bin Buz Yaprağı)
jutsu.name_en: Ice Release: Ten Thousand Ice Petals
jutsu.literal_en: Ice Release: Ten Thousand Ice Petals
jutsu.canon_description: The user unleashes a barrage of ice darts. The intensity of the cold is so great, that should a person attempt to block them, it will cause severe damage to the afflicted limb. The user can also use this defensively by creating a wall of ice to create distance between the user and their combatant.

jutsu.name: Raikyū (Şimşek Topu)
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates spheres of electrical energy and launches them at the enemy. When they make contact with the enemy, the spheres electrocute them and throw them back. This technique can also be used in rapid succession or fire multiple balls at once.

jutsu.name: Raiton: Raiga (Şimşek Dişi)
jutsu.canon_description: Using Kiba, the user sends bolts of lightning to electrocute their enemies.

jutsu.name: Raiton: Hiraishin (Paratoner)
jutsu.canon_description: After coming into physical contact with the opponent, the user raises their arm into the air, generating a powerful bolt of electricity which travels through their body transferring the electricity to the body of the opponent.

jutsu.name: Raiton: Amigumo (Şimşek Örümcek Ağı)
jutsu.canon_description: After kneading chakra in the body and converting it to lightning, the user places their hand on the ground, releasing a surge of electricity around them in the form of a web, which electrocutes anyone caught in its vicinity.

jutsu.name: Raiton: Sandāgēto (Gök Gürültüsü Kapısı)
jutsu.kanji: 雷遁・<ruby>迅雷門<rt>サンダーゲート</rt></ruby>
jutsu.canon_description: The user first buries Kiba’s blades into the ground and then sends out an electrical charge towards the sky, which in turn, causes lightning to fall from the sky decimating the immediate area around the user, burning everything to a crisp.

jutsu.name: Raiton: Kaminari Shibari (Gök Gürültüsü Bağı)
jutsu.canon_description: This technique lets the user create a three-sided wall of electricity to bind their opponent. The user must have three conductors to stick in the ground to create the points. Furthermore, once the enemy is inside, if they come into contact with the wall they will be electrocuted. The only way the te

jutsu.name: Raiton: Jibashi (Elektromanyetik Ölüm)
jutsu.canon_description: A Lightning Release technique that allows the user to create a wave of electricity from their hands. The user can vary its power from a small surge to shock an opponent to a powerful stream of lightning capable of ripping through solid rock.

jutsu.name: Raigeki (Şimşek Darbesi)
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates an electric current that can hit multiple individuals at the same time. Furthermore, it can extend incredible distances and avoid obstacles.

jutsu.name: Sōsai no Ne (Ses Dengeleme)
jutsu.desc: Sesle ses tabanlı tekniği iptal etme.
jutsu.canon_description: A genjutsu that relies on the sound of the ocarina. While playing the melody, the user is able to release his allies from powerful genjutsu, such as the ones used by Shiin and his clansmen.

jutsu.name: Fūjinheki (Hızlı Rüzgâr Duvarı)
jutsu.canon_description: The user summons a swirling stream of wind, encasing the user and repelling incoming attacks. It can also be expanded to protect others near the user.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Kokuu no Jutsu (Kara Yağmur)
jutsu.desc: Yanıcı yağlı kara yağmur; ateşle birleşince patlar.
jutsu.canon_description: This technique creates a flammable black mist that forms a small cloud. The user can then move the cloud above their target and disperse it, covering the target in flammable oil. This technique was first used to burn down Idate Morino's boat, after it was lit with fire.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Ja no Kuchi (Yılan Ağzı)
jutsu.canon_description: The user generates a spinning column of water which takes the form of a snake with a gaping jaw. This snake can twist and follow its targets and swallow them. After it has swallowed them, it turns into a river that carries the targets away.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Mizu Shuriken (Su Şurikeni)
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates a large amount of shuriken, made out of water, and throws them at the opponent in quick succession.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Suiben (Su Kırbacı)
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates a whip made of water that can wrap around the opponent. The user can also channel lightning chakra to shock anyone wrapped in it. This technique seems to be known by the Kirigakure hunter-nin. It's also strong enough to completely counter Yamato's Wood Release.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Suisandan (Su Saçması)
jutsu.canon_description: The user spits several blade-like projectiles, strong enough to penetrate protective armor.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Amefuribari (Yağmur İğneleri)
jutsu.canon_description: By using the existing rain around them, the user infuses their chakra into the individual raindrops, sharpening them into ultra-thin needles to fall down and skew their targets. Because of its minuscule nature and how they blend in with the rest of the rain, it is hard for a person to discern the tr

jutsu.name: Fūton: Gōfū Bōheki (Büyük Rüzgâr Koruyucu Duvar)
jutsu.name_en: Wind Release: Great Wind Protective Wall
jutsu.canon_description: Using her Giant Folding Fan, Temari creates a wind wall that pushes her opponents away.

jutsu.name: Fūton: Hanachiri Mai (Çiçek Saçan Dans)
jutsu.canon_description: This technique allows the user to summon a cyclone of petals to attack their opponent. The user can remain in one spot for the use of the technique, because they can direct it anywhere they desire. Therefore, the user can increase the direction and power of the technique to the maximum as a last res

jutsu.name: Bakuton: Shōgeki (Patlama Darbesi)
jutsu.canon_description: Gari punches the ground, the explosion causing the earth to upturn, unbalancing his opponents.

jutsu.name: Ningyō Kibaku Nendo (Patlayıcı Kil Bebekler)
jutsu.canon_description: Deidara releases a glob of explosive clay from both his hands that he forms into deformed human-like figures. Deidara then uses them to fight his opponent in close combat. Their body structure allows them to extend their body parts and not be sliced by normal means, however, a lightning-infused chop

jutsu.name: Katon: Gōka Senpū (Büyük Ateş Kasırgası)
jutsu.canon_description: Madara swings his war fan and breathes fire into the swing, creating a wall of flaming whirlwinds.

jutsu.name: Katon: Kaen Senpū (Alev Kasırgası)
jutsu.canon_description: Fire erupts around the user's body in a spiralling manner which is then launched with his hands towards the target. Once the technique hits the target, the opponent is sent into the air in a spiralling manner and their body burns into ashes.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Mizu Shibari (Su Bağı)
jutsu.canon_description: The user produces large tendrils from behind. They are highly malleable, able to twist and constrict as needed. They are also very strong, able to easily lift and subdue a grown man, potentially able to crush their victims.

jutsu.name: Suiton: Abare Kurage (Öfkeli Denizanası)
jutsu.canon_description: Funamushi creates a giant water jellyfish, which he rides and controls. With its tentacles, it can cause widespread destruction and attack multiple targets at once. Funamushi only employed it in combat when he had access to a significant amount of water provided by rainfall. Despite his Water Releas

jutsu.name: Jōki Bakushin (Buhar Atılışı)
jutsu.canon_description: After increasing their chakra temperature to its boiling point, the user releases boiling steam from their body, after which, they dash straight at the opponent in a straight line, taking the similar approach to a locomotive and creating sounds, which are similar to the ones made by a steam whistle.

jutsu.name: Ressenpū (Şiddetli Kasırga)
jutsu.canon_description: The user produces a powerful stream of wind from their mouth. This technique was powerful enough to dispel several shadow clones in an instant.

jutsu.name: Mokuton: Jukai Heki (Ağaçlar Duvarı)
jutsu.name_en: Wood Release: World of Trees Wall
jutsu.literal_en: Wood Release: World of Trees Wall
jutsu.canon_description: The user creates countless wooden branches that grow at high speed from the ground. The branches interlace to form a wide, net-like wall with an impressive defensive power.

jutsu.name: Nadeshiko-Ryū Kōha Reppūken (Nadeşiko Sert Rüzgâr Yumruğu)
jutsu.canon_description: By covering one's own hand with wind-natured chakra, the user attacks the enemy with it. The force of the strike is great enough to produce a powerful shockwave that can cause noticeable fissures without direct contact.

jutsu.name: Jigyaku no Jutsu (Zaman Geri Sarma)
jutsu.canon_description: This technique is used by the Anbu to pull out forgotten memories. After forming the appropriate hand seals, the Anbu will put the target into a state of reverse hypnosis, allowing them to remember details that they otherwise would not. jutsu.name: Katon: Tenrō (Göksel Hapis)
jutsu.canon_description: The Fire Release: Heavenly Prison is an imprisonment technique used by Mui's clan.

jutsu.name: Wind Release: Air Bullets (Hava Mermileri)
jutsu.desc: Ağızdan sıkıştırılmış hava mermileri; patlayarak geri iter.
jutsu.canon_description: This technique shoots multiple bullets of air at the victim with intense speed. The bullets also have great power, enough to subdue a whole group of shinobi.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Cheap fast invisible-ish projectiles (distortion VFX). Learn: genin.

jutsu.name: Earth Release: Rock Shelter (Kaya Sığınağı)
jutsu.desc: Kullanıcı ve müttefikleri kaya kubbeyle korur.
jutsu.canon_description: The user surrounds themselves with earth, taken from the immediate vicinity  and creates a formation of rock that is capable of protecting both the user and others in close proximity, if desired. Doing so, seemingly leaves the surrounding terrain unaltered, even when the quantity of earth used is en
jutsu.game_suggestion: Group shield dome for 3 s. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.name: Gatsūga (Diş Geçen Diş)
jutsu.desc: Ninja köpeğiyle birlikte dönen matkap gibi çift hücum.
jutsu.canon_description: An Inuzuka and their ninken companion both perform the Passing Fang, whereby they rotate their bodies and deliver a series of rapid body blows to a target. jutsu.game_suggestion: Drill-dash done together with a dog companion pet. Learn: clan; requires ninken companion bond level.

jutsu.name: Hachimon (Sekiz Kapı)
jutsu.desc: Bedendeki sekiz çakra kapısının sınırlarını kaldırma sistemi; her kapı gücü artırır, bedeni yıpratır.
jutsu.canon_description: The Eight Gates are eight specific tenketsu along the chakra pathway system.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Tiered self-buff: each gate opened gives big stat boost and HP drain; gate 8 = death (game over or permanent loss). Learn: gated progression via a taijutsu master; one gate per arc.

jutsu.name: Gyaku Kuchiyose no Jutsu (Ters Çağırma)
jutsu.desc: Sözleşmeli hayvanlar kullanıcıyı kendi yanlarına çağırır; uzak bölgeye kaçış/ulaşım.
jutsu.canon_description: The contracted animals summon the user to their location instead.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Out-of-combat teleport to a summon realm hub (training / sage area). Learn: unlocked by summon-contract questline.

jutsu.desc: Hedefin çevresinde şimşek yayan dört sütun yükselir; içindekini felç eder.
jutsu.canon_description: Raises four pillars around the target which emit lightning, trapping and paralysing them.

jutsu.game_suggestion: Targeted delayed strike from above with AoE stun. Learn: chunin.

jutsu.desc: Hedefleri düz yürüdüklerini sanırken daireler çizdirir; yol kaybettirme illüzyonu.
jutsu.canon_description: Makes targets believe they are walking in a straight line while they are actually led in circles.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Field genjutsu: enemies/pursuers inside zone wander or patrol in circles; great for stealth/escape. Learn: genin/chunin.

jutsu.desc: Yerden tam bir ahşap ev büyütür; kamp ve sığınak.
jutsu.canon_description: Grows a full wooden house from the ground.
jutsu.game_suggestion: Camp/rest point anywhere in the open world (save + heal). Learn: Wood Release bloodline.
